parameters.help_en:
The templatetype. Valid values:  
Timeline: standard template. It is created based on the timeline of a video clip project, where multiple materials are spliced across multiple layers. It supports effects such as text-to-video, photo albums, intros and outros, and default watermarks.
VETemplate: advanced template. It is created based on Adobe After Effects (AE) effects to achieve advanced media effects with complex motion graphics.
BatchEditing: one-click video generation template. It supports parameters such as sticker watermarks, background music, background images, voiceover subtitle styles, title subtitle styles, and output resolution. These parameters are automatically applied when a one-click video generation node is committed
parameters.help_zh:
模板类型，目前支持：  
Timeline（普通模板）：基于视频剪辑工程的Timeline（时间线内多个素材，多图层形式进行前后拼接）创建的模板，可实现图文转视频、图片相册、片头片尾、默认水印等效果。
VETemplate（高级模板）：基于AE（Adobe After Effects）特效创建的模板，可实现复杂动效样式的高级媒体效果。
BatchEditing (一键成片模版)：支持配置贴纸水印、背景音乐、背景图片、口播字幕样式、标题字幕样式、输出分辨率等参数，提交一键成片任务时自动应用
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The Config parameter for standard templates is an encapsulation based on the cloud editing timeline. Custom template configurations are more flexible. If you have special requirements, familiarize yourself with the Config structure and customize the template. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/456193.html.
For more Config examples, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451634.html.
For the Config settings of one-click video generation templates, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2878274.html
parameters.help_zh:
普通模板Config是基于云剪辑Timeline的封装，自定义模板Config会更加灵活。如果您有特殊需求，建议熟悉Config结构并自定义模板，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/456193.html。
更多模板Config示例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451634.html。
一键成片模版Config配置，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2878274.html
